Auth.tagline: Match jobs to your experience and track every application.

import.title: Import your resume
import.body: Upload a PDF or Word file. You review the extracted profile before anything is saved.

paste.title: Paste a job posting
paste.body: Add a link or paste the description, and the requirements are extracted for you.

score.title: Get a fit score with reasons
score.body: See which requirements you meet, the evidence from your profile, and where the gaps are.

track.title: Track every application
track.body: Move each application across your board, from saved to offer, with next steps and due dates.

privacy.title: How your resume is used
privacy.body: Your resume is used only to match you with jobs and tailor your applications. It is not shared with other users or sold. To do this, its text is processed by Claude (Anthropic) and, for matching, by Voyage AI.

import.title: Import from a resume

boards.title: Browse a job board
boards.description: Paste a link to a company's job board on Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby (or to any posting on it) to see its open postings, then import the ones you want.
boards.privacy: The listing is read from the board's public API. Importing a posting sends its text to Claude (Anthropic) and Voyage AI, as when you add a job.

Resumes.title: Resumes
Resumes.description: Versions of your resume tailored to specific jobs. Your master profile is never changed.
Resumes.empty: No tailored resumes yet. Open a job and choose Tailor resume.

tailor.title: Tailor your resume
tailor.languageNote: Written in {language}, your resume language. Tailoring never translates.
tailor.privacy: Your profile and the job's requirements are sent to Claude (Anthropic), which proposes which achievements to keep and how to word them. It can only reorder, trim and reword what's already in your profile. Nothing is saved until you review it.
tailor.generatingHint: This can take up to a minute.
